newsitem.title: USA: SABRE names SiteSpecific as agency.
newsitem.headline: SABRE names SiteSpecific as agency.

text.p: SABRE Group Holdings Inc said Tuesday that SiteSpecific, a New York-based Internet marketing and media group, will be the agency of record for its easySABRE and Travelocity brands.
Travelocity is a travel planning Web site, while easySABRE is an online travel reservation system.
SiteSpecific will devise an online advertising campaign in 1997, while Meyer & Johnson will continue to provide support for marketing communications projects, SABRE said.
